title: robots.txt blocks AI-assistant / search crawlers from core content
evidence: robots.txt disallows: GPTBot, Google-Extended, ChatGPT-User, CCBot, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot at https://www.nytimes.com/robots.txt

suggested_action.summary: Remove or narrow the Disallow rules for AI/search agents so core content paths (product, blog, docs, marketing) are fetchable; keep auth/cart paths blocked.
Publish a sitemap.xml listing all indexable URLs and reference it in robots.txt so new/updated pages are discovered faster.
